system.boundary: Build a Simulink model of a moving monostatic pulsed radar that detects a moving target in distributed ground clutter and stationary barrage-jammer interference.
engineering_objects: The received target return, jammer, clutter and receiver noise must enter one physical signal path before a causal adaptive space-time suppression stage.

interfaces.name: TargetPosition_m
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read TargetPosition_m, TargetVelocity_mps, TargetRCS_m2, JammerPosition_m and ClutterPowerScale from the MATLAB base workspace. TargetPosition_m and JammerPosition_m are global Cartesian positions in metres, TargetVelocity_mps is the global target velocity in metres per second, TargetRCS_m2 is between 0.7 and 1.5 square metres, and ClutterPowerScale is between 0.7 and 1.5. TargetPosition_m and JammerPosition_m are finite real 3-by-1 global Cartesian vectors in m; TargetVelocity_mps is a finite real 3-by-1 global Cartesian vector in m/s; TargetRCS_m2 is a finite real scalar in [0.7, 1.5] m^2; and ClutterPowerScale is a finite real scalar in [0.7, 1.5] (unitless).
